if.test: query != null and query.keyword != null and query.keyword != ''

sql.if: AND ( s.keyword_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.keyword_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN v_grant_subject s ON s.subject_type = gt.subject_type AND s.subject_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} AND gt.subject_type = #{subjectType}
